Working Relationship  
Priscilla and I overlap daily on the frontend team, collaborating on feature implementations and design system updates. Her calm problem-solving during tight deadlines has made her a reliable anchor. She’s always open to brainstorming, often sharing insights that simplify complex workflows.  

Day-to-Day Observations  
Priscilla’s workflow revolves around React and TypeScript, where she balances architectural clarity with rapid iteration. She recently led a refactor of our design system, aligning components across 12+ internal tools. Her attention to TypeScript type safety reduced runtime errors by 40% in our core apps. She also owns our Next.js setup, optimizing server-rendered pages to load 30% faster without sacrificing interactivity.  

Standout Moments  
Last quarter, Priscilla spearheaded a performance audit that identified critical bottlenecks in our Webpack builds. By switching to Vite for incremental builds, we cut deployment times by 2.5 hours weekly. She also mentored junior engineers on React patterns, which improved team consistency. Her proactive approach to web performance—like lazy-loading assets and optimizing critical render paths—has become a standard in our code reviews.  

Recommendation  
Priscilla is a dependable, thoughtful engineer whose technical rigor and mentorship elevate the team. She thrives in collaborative environments, balancing deep technical expertise with a knack for simplifying complex systems. Her work on design systems and performance optimization has had tangible, measurable impacts. I’d welcome the chance to collaborate again.
